global_options.description: Key-value pairs for global oidentd settings (e.g., 'default_allow yes').

oidentd_behind_proxy.description: Whether the host is behind a masquerading router acting as an oidentd proxy. Must be 'yes' or 'no'.

oidentd_limit_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous oidentd connections to allow.

oidentd_user.description: User account under which oidentd runs.

users.description: List of users with custom ident response rules.
